"I can tell you nothing you don't already know."

He glances at Callistege, as if daring her to contradict him.

"Do you want to know how it has grown? How the Slave Families rule still? How the hoards of numenera grow, or how people still flock to the city? Maybe you'd like to hear about the crushing poverty, or perhaps you're more concerned with the plight of the wealthy." He shakes his head. "It's still a place of wonders, I'll give you that."

"It's a city of ancient wonders, the first and last defense against the vicious Tabaht - Sagus Cliffs still bears the scars of those battles. Those who seek wisdom flock here to study the numenera. History rubs cheeks with promises for the future, and it's a place to make a name for yourself, no matter what your calling."

He smiles crookedly. "Is that enough of an answer for you?"

"My chiurgical parlor is a marvel of the prior world, you see. Just pick an item or a service, pay my outrageous fees, and after only a short to long period of fairly safe but indescribable agony, you walk away with some horrible numenera bits whirring away inside you."

He pokes a few buttons on a device strapped to his wrist, and lights twinkle across its length. A dark, glassy lens focuses on you.

"Well? Interested?"

changes.source: "Best part is, we've sacrificed our lives, our friends, and our sanity for a city that'll never know. They keep on with their daily lives, and just assume the rash of madness is some effect of the numenera. Gave up the best part of our minds, and they don't even care. Doesn't matter to me what the rabble think, but it'd be nice to at least get some professional recognition..."
changes.before: “最妙的是，我们为一个永远不会知道真相的城市牺牲了生命、朋友和理智。他们照旧过着自己的日子，只当那阵疯病是努曼内拉的某种效应。我们交出了心智中最好的部分，他们却根本不在乎。那群乌合之众怎么想，我无所谓，但至少能得到一点专业的认可就好了……”

I have seen everything between here and the Steadfast, and I have studied numenera of all kinds for decades. There is no man more knowledgeable about the Ninth World than he who sits before you, I assure you."

He taps various relics on his person. "Never seen the like, have you? Fortunately for you, I *adore* educating folks on the subject of the numenera. I've also traveled extensively and seen much of the world. Go ahead, ask me whatever you would like to know."

changes.source: His eyes light up - as, too, do a number of devices on his person, though you cannot see why. "The numenera are practically everything around you. We live among the detritus of *uncountable* civilizations, many of which were more powerful than you or even I can imagine. Everything they left us is the numenera - weapons, power sources, medicines, gels, plants, animals... why even the very drit in the ground and shins in your pocket are examples of numenera."

He takes a puff from his pipe. "In any case, it is the numenera that power the wonders of the world, from an explorer's esoteries to the datasphere to the drinks in this very tavern."

changes.source: He counts each one on his fingers. "Many devices deal with *fundamental forces* - gravity, magnetism, sound, light, even time itself. Automatons and created intelligences fall under *artificial life*. *Biotechnology* covers a wide variety of numenera - many plants and animals that we consider 'natural' were in fact created by prior worlds for some arcane purpose. The Bloom may fall under this category. Someday I'll hire a team to find out, if I can find anyone reckless enough."

His eyes light up. "The most interesting are also the most esoteric. *Nanotechnology* - which covers much of what common folk consider 'magic' - *transdimensional tech*, and technology related to the *datasphere* itself."

He leans back, reinserting his pipe. "But these are just the classifications *I* prefer. The numenera defy definition."

"While the others dithered and wailed, I bent my mind to the future," it continues. "I analyzed the work we had done for the Cartographers. To my shame, I found *flaws* in the processes. I removed them." 

Its eyes burn brighter. "For the next cluster of centuries, I studied the vast catalogue of known technology and numenera in my mind and strung them together, creating new inventions for the day when the Cartographers returned and reactivated us."

He sighs. "But that day never came."

"You saw the monument to Ormen, the aldeia where I was an Aeon Priest. It used to be the place where my people went to memorialize the dead. Never used the Necropolis - just sketched some memories onto the wall." He looks down.

"I had to remember them all. Someone activated some old numenera. Wiped out my village... or disappeared them, at least. I've been looking for what happened to them... and on the trail of the person responsible."

changes.source: "The Reef? It's a junkyard. Look. Over there, a construct the Tabaht used to attack the city. A fallen spacefaring vessel. I have no idea what some of these obelisks are. What it all has in common is that it's abandoned, old, and mostly dead." He smiles wryly, "Truth is, the Reef is a numenera-picker's dream, and it's a draw for scavengers and treasure hunters. Dangerous... especially because the artifacts here still hold some secrets and power."

changes.source: "You want *me* to tell *you*?" He laughs without mirth. "The numenera are all around you, everything left over from the prior worlds. Sagus Cliffs thrives by trading artifacts from ancient civilizations. Hells, you can't scoop a handful of earth without finding drit from prior worlds mixed with it."

changes.source: "Numenera is anything from the prior worlds, but mostly we mean the stuff of value to us. A lot of the numenera are just oddities, fancy trinkets with little real use, but sometimes you'll get a cypher that lets you do something incredible. Artifacts are worth even more - a cypher will only do something once, but artifacts last a lot longer. Though they *can* burn out at the most inconvenient times." He frowns. "Not that it's ever happened to me."

changes.source:
She sighs.

"When I was younger... *much* younger, if you can believe such a time existed, I spent my days hunting down dangerous numenera that no one else would touch. Devices that could obliterate rock and flesh alike, swarms of stronglass insects that would inject an explosive poison into all who came near, mysteries of that nature. Naturally, it attracted a certain type of person." A smile quirks her mouth.

changes.source:
"After some time and several bidding wars, I became close with another explorer. At first it was a wary alliance, formed when we had too few shins and far too much curiosity. But eventually we came to trust one another, rely on the other being there as an extra pair of hands if the danger grew too great. It was..." She exhales forcefully.

"How to describe it? To hold potent numenera in your hands, to understand it, to *tame* it. I was enthralled."
changes.before:
“过了一段时间，又经历了数场竞价战后，我和另一名探险者变得亲近起来。起初，那是一种戒备的同盟，形成于我们囊中辛币太少、好奇心又实在太多的时候。但最终，我们开始互相信任，依赖对方在危险变得过大时作为额外的一双手出现。那是……”她用力呼出一口气。

“该怎么说呢？把强大的努曼内拉握在手中，理解它，*驯服*它。我深深着迷。”

"Then, before I could warn her, before I could say anything, I was back here, in this world without her, the numenera a smoking ruin at my feet. But I knew she was alive. Somewhere. I searched every text I could find and came to the conclusion that she was less than a heartbeat away. Yet, for all that, it may as well have been eternity." She twines her fingers together so tightly the knuckles show white.

"I knew I had to find her again, whatever it took. And I did. Yet... I did not."
changes.before:
“然后，在我能警告她之前，在我能说出任何话之前，我已经返回了这里，在这个没有她的世界，努曼内拉在我脚边化作冒烟的废墟。但我知道她还活着。在某个地方。我查遍了所有能找到的文本，最终得出结论：她离我不到一次心跳的距离。然而，尽管如此，那也等同于永恒。”她把手指紧紧绞在一起，指节都发白了。

“我知道我必须再次找到她，不惜一切代价。我做到了。可是……我并没有。”

Aligern returned to the Bloom, seeking the metal frame that Orth Faung had requested. He found it at last, and his colleague told him the truth - the tattoos that Aligern had regarded as a curse were the transformed villagers of Ormen, their data carried in biological light and transplanted into his skin.

Aligern discovered how he might free his family and friends from the cursed tattoos. Some of the villagers suffered permanent damage, and Aligern devoted his remaining days to caring for those he had harmed. He refused to deal with the numenera again.

He was buried in Ormen. They scratched his name on the wall of the Valley of Dead Heroes.

Your voice says, "Today marks the twenty-eighth anniversary of the siege of Sagus Cliffs. Twenty-eight years since her illness began. It was a simple thing to defeat them - to unmoor the city from the present and strip those trapped inside of their numenera. It has not proven so simple to undo the effects their terror unleashed on us. I still don't know how the surrimene crystal *works* nor what it does to its victims. I doubt they knew either, but they were pillagers not priests. They only knew it was a weapon."

The voice sighs. "I wonder if they knew the extent of its power, how it could destroy the life of a young woman and her father, even chasing them *across* lives."

Rough-hewn stairs lead to an enormous room, more cavern than hall, that ends in wooden gates. 

The chiming of the wards is louder, faster. The chatter of the dead is incessant. But more than anything you feel the weight of Inifere's will, and the bloody purpose to which it is put. All these years, he has expected your father's return. His mind repeats over and over, <Not helpless, not again, not helpless, not again.>

You know what he knows: that under the floor there are numenera, that hidden in cracks and crevices are cyphers. You see what he sees: the faithful girding themselves for battle.

This is not a homecoming. It is an ambush.

Your mission was to cut, and so you cut: the Speaker's throat first, and not a word more does she say. 

The rest of the Folk are at first so stunned that they do nothing. You waste neither time nor motion in slicing them down. After a short span, they rally themselves into action. 

It is futile. No doubt they could have killed the mute boy, but they cannot kill you. A few glancing blows and shallow cuts come your way, but in the end the blood that soaks the sterncastle floor is not yours.

Through it all, the Gift sits, docile. There is no cause to kill him. He watches as you smash the key parts of the numenera. The hall falls dark as the energy goes, but the boy watches you still.

The Speaker takes the warning well, as if she'd expected as much. "I cannot fault those who speak for your city. We have done the same here to safeguard the uninfected within these walls."

"But we cannot change course from here." She points to the window through which the numenera sends its energy. "The Whalesinger guides the whale from upon its head. And he must be shielded against plague - were he to lose his voice, there would be no song to steer us." 

A grim sort of smile hardens on her face. "But there is a way. You see, a Gift has come to us, a means by which the Healer can concoct an inoculation against the Quiet Death. It comes at a price, one your city will make us pay."

changes.source: Tybir may not know a lot about the numenera, but he can fake it better than most. The difficulty of any Lore-related task is reduced by 3 for Tybir and all of his allies.
changes.before: 泰比尔或许对努曼内拉所知不多，但他比大多数人更擅长不懂装懂。对泰比尔及其所有盟友而言，任何学识相关检定的难度降低3点。
changes.after: 泰比尔或许对扭蒙拉所知不多，但他比大多数人更擅长不懂装懂。对泰比尔及其所有盟友而言，任何学识相关检定的难度降低3点。

changes.source: Aligern has spent his life knee-deep in drit, studying numenera of every kind. His allies benefit from his vast knowledge.
changes.before: 阿利格恩一生都深陷德里特之中，研究过各种努曼内拉。他的盟友受益于他渊博的知识。
changes.after: 阿利格恩一生都深陷德里特之中，研究过各种扭蒙拉。他的盟友受益于他渊博的知识。

changes.source:
"Nature took the life she gave; Numenera restored but a husk.

Touched by Numenera of Glaive; Here I bide until the Ninth is at dusk.
I will walk the Tenth. You will suffer! You will ALL suffer!"
changes.before:
“自然取回了她所赐予的生命；努曼内拉复活的不过是一具空壳。

受刃卫的努曼内拉所触碰；我在此等待，直到第九世界归于黄昏。
我将行走于第十世界。你们将受苦！你们全都会受苦！”

changes.source: Residing in the Underbelly's Manufactory are three large constructs. Millennia ago, these Foremen built and maintained massive starships. Though they can no longer move, they are still able to direct the efforts of human laborers. The Foremen are constantly devising better ways to fabricate materials and rework the numenera to benefit Sagus Cliffs.
changes.before: 下层区制造厂中居住着三个大型构造体。数千年前，这些工头建造并维护了巨型星舰。尽管它们如今已无法移动，却仍能指挥人类劳工劳作。工头们不断设计更好的方法来制造材料、改造努曼内拉，以造福萨古斯悬崖。
changes.after: 下层区制造厂中居住着三个大型构造体。数千年前，这些工头建造并维护了巨型星舰。尽管它们如今已无法移动，却仍能指挥人类劳工劳作。工头们不断设计更好的方法来制造材料、改造扭蒙拉，以造福萨古斯悬崖。

changes.source: The Order of Truth stretches far across the Ninth World, though its philosophies and activities differ from place to place. Its primary goal is to use the tools of the vanished worlds to help restore humanity to greatness. Those who join the Order are called "Aeon Priests", though they are not a religion. Instead, they prize intellect, understanding, and a deep comprehension of the wonders of the ancient world. Across the world, people trust Aeon Priests to handle, identify, and use the numenera.
changes.before: 真理教团遍布第九世界，尽管其哲学与活动因地而异。它的首要目标是利用消逝世界的工具，帮助人类重归伟大。加入教团的人被称为“万世祭司”，尽管这并非一种宗教。他们推崇智力、理解力，以及对古代世界奇观的深刻领悟。世界各地的人都信任万世祭司来处理、辨识和使用努曼内拉。
changes.after: 真理教团遍布第九世界，尽管其哲学与活动因地而异。它的首要目标是利用消逝世界的工具，帮助人类重归伟大。加入教团的人被称为“万世祭司”，尽管这并非一种宗教。他们推崇智力、理解力，以及对古代世界奇观的深刻领悟。世界各地的人都信任万世祭司来处理、辨识和使用扭蒙拉。

changes.source: Sir Arthour Torein is a traveler and one of the foremost experts on the numenera... at least, that's what he says. He makes his home in the Steadfast, and has one of the most extensive libraries about the numenera in the known world. He is always on the move, seeking to build upon his existing knowledge.
changes.before: 阿瑟·托雷因爵士是一名旅行者，也是研究努曼内拉最杰出的专家之一……至少他自己是这么说的。他把坚定之地当作家园，并拥有已知世界中最丰富的努曼内拉藏书之一。他始终四处奔波，力求在现有知识的基础上更进一步。
changes.after: 阿瑟·托雷因爵士是一名旅行者，也是研究扭蒙拉最杰出的专家之一……至少他自己是这么说的。他把坚定之地当作家园，并拥有已知世界中最丰富的扭蒙拉藏书之一。他始终四处奔波，力求在现有知识的基础上更进一步。

changes.after: 这件作品的标题是：“扭蒙拉 DLC 宣传图”

changes.source: Hundreds of broken numenera are piled here. The workers are scavenging them for parts if they're useful... or throwing them into the furnace if they're not.
changes.before: 数百件破碎的努曼内拉器物堆在这里。工人们从中拾荒：有用的就拆下零件……没用的就扔进熔炉。
changes.after: 数百件破碎的扭蒙拉器物堆在这里。工人们从中拾荒：有用的就拆下零件……没用的就扔进熔炉。

changes.source: This immense pile is comprised of shiny baubles, decorative objects, and broken bits of numenera. Most of the 'treasure' has no practical value whatsoever.
changes.before: 这一大堆东西由闪亮的小玩意、装饰品和破碎的努曼内拉残片组成。大部分“宝物”根本没有任何实用价值。
changes.after: 这一大堆东西由闪亮的小玩意、装饰品和破碎的扭蒙拉残片组成。大部分“宝物”根本没有任何实用价值。

changes.source: This small mechanical device fits comfortably in a human hand. It fires thumbnail-sized, razor-sharp discs.\n\nWhile these devices are sometimes made from scavenged numenera, skilled artisans can craft them from raw parts. They're fairly common weapons, though still valued and dangerous.
changes.before: 这台小型机械装置可舒适地握在人类手中。它能发射指甲盖大小、锋利如剃刀的圆盘。\n\n虽然这些装置有时由回收来的努曼内拉制成，但熟练工匠也能用原始零件制造它们。它们相当常见，却仍然珍贵而危险。
changes.after: 这台小型机械装置可舒适地握在人类手中。它能发射指甲盖大小、锋利如剃刀的圆盘。\n\n虽然这些装置有时由回收来的扭蒙拉制成，但熟练工匠也能用原始零件制造它们。它们相当常见，却仍然珍贵而危险。

changes.source: This is a long, metal device with a narrow tube and a trigger mechanism. It has an opening to feed tiny slugs of metal into the tube. With a quiet puff of air, it fires these slugs rapidly and at high velocity.\n\nSome slugspitters are cobbled together from other numenera, while others are ancient weapons that survived the ages intact. Producing a slugspitter from scratch is beyond the reach of Ninth World human technology.
changes.before: 这是一件狭长的金属装置，带有一根细管和一套触发器机构。它有一个开口，可将微小的金属弹丸送入管中。伴随着轻微的气流声，它会以极高速度连续发射这些弹丸。\n\n有些弹丸喷射枪是用其他努曼内拉拼凑而成的，另一些则是历经漫长岁月仍完好无损的古代武器。从零开始制造弹丸喷射枪，超出了第九世界人类技术的触及范围。

changes.source: This moss-covered pebble looks almost ordinary, and if it were lying on the ground, it would be difficult to spot. But the moss shifts in unexpected ways, and the pebble vibrates as it does. If held against the skin, the moss latches on and is absorbed, providing powerful resuscitating energies. These pebbles are found by diving into the waters around Sagus Cliffs, perhaps grown by an unknown interaction with the surrounding numenera.
changes.before: 这颗覆满苔藓的卵石看上去几乎平平无奇，如果它躺在地上，想发现它会很困难。但苔藓会以意想不到的方式移动，卵石也随之振动。若将它贴在皮肤上，苔藓便会附着并被吸收，提供强效的复苏能量。潜入萨古斯悬崖周围的水域便能找到这些卵石，它们或许是在与周围的努曼内拉发生未知相互作用后生长而成。
changes.after: 这颗覆满苔藓的卵石看上去几乎平平无奇，如果它躺在地上，想发现它会很困难。但苔藓会以意想不到的方式移动，卵石也随之振动。若将它贴在皮肤上，苔藓便会附着并被吸收，提供强效的复苏能量。潜入萨古斯悬崖周围的水域便能找到这些卵石，它们或许是在与周围的扭蒙拉发生未知相互作用后生长而成。

changes.source: Tales tell of a jack and a glaive who dug deep under the earth. They finally uncovered a treasure trove of numenera, but one particular artifact, a dangerous weapon bright with power, caught both their eyes. They agreed to flip an old coin for it, a lucky token of the jack's, but as he flipped it in the air, the glaive grabbed the item and fired it at the jack. Later, the rest of their companions caught up with them, finding only two corpses and the coin, still spinning in the air, flying from one treasure to another. They decided to take the coin but left the rest... including the corpses.
changes.before: 传说讲述了一位游侠和一位刃卫在大地深处挖掘的故事。他们最终发现了一批努曼内拉宝物，但其中一件神器尤为引人注目，那是一件闪耀着力量的危险武器，同时吸引了两人的目光。他们商定用一枚旧硬币来决定归属，那是游侠的一枚幸运信物；可当他把硬币抛向空中时，刃卫一把夺过那件物品，朝游侠开了火。后来，他们其余的同伴赶了上来，只发现两具尸体和那枚硬币，它仍在空中旋转，从一件宝物飞向另一件宝物。他们决定拿走那枚硬币，却留下了其余的一切……包括那些尸体。

changes.source: This translucent creature loosely and freely floats before you, lazily pushing its way through the air. You can discern no external or internal organs, and its skin is pliable and soft to the touch. When placed over the head, it teleports the user to a different dimension, where they can meet with transdimensional peddlers interested in buying up all sorts of Numenera.
changes.before: 这只半透明的生物松散而自在地漂浮在你面前，懒洋洋地在空气中穿行。你看不出它有任何外部或内部器官，它的皮肤柔韧，摸上去很软。把它罩在头上时，它会将用户传送到另一个维度，在那里，用户可以与有意收购各类努曼内拉的跨维度行商见面。
changes.after: 这只半透明的生物松散而自在地漂浮在你面前，懒洋洋地在空气中穿行。你看不出它有任何外部或内部器官，它的皮肤柔韧，摸上去很软。把它罩在头上时，它会将用户传送到另一个维度，在那里，用户可以与有意收购各类扭蒙拉的跨维度行商见面。

changes.source: A simple and effective explosive. Devices like these have been the bane of many who've had the misfortune of encountering them. Cobbled together from junk and numenera, this detonation can have wild and unexpected effects when hurled at the enemy.\n\nRumors have it that most of the unlucky victims of these devices were the people trying to use them, for their instability makes them just as dangerous to their owners as to their enemies.
changes.before: 一件简单而有效的爆炸物。像这样的装置曾让许多不幸遇上它们的人吃尽苦头。这个爆弹由垃圾与努曼内拉拼凑而成，掷向敌人时可能产生狂野而难以预料的效果。\n\n传言称，这些装置的大多数倒霉受害者正是试图使用它们的人，因为其不稳定性使它们对主人与对敌人同样危险。
changes.after: 一件简单而有效的爆炸物。像这样的装置曾让许多不幸遇上它们的人吃尽苦头。这个爆弹由垃圾与扭蒙拉拼凑而成，掷向敌人时可能产生狂野而难以预料的效果。\n\n传言称，这些装置的大多数倒霉受害者正是试图使用它们的人，因为其不稳定性使它们对主人与对敌人同样危险。

changes.source: This shield is made of a polished emerald material. It can take the heaviest of blows without showing so much as a crack. Four gemstones are embedded in the shield in the pattern of a ceturl's eyes. These gems are imbued with numenera and slow all enemies who land blows on the shield.
changes.before: 这面盾牌由打磨过的翡翠质材料制成。它能承受最沉重的打击，连一丝裂纹都不会显现。盾牌上嵌有四颗宝石，排列成塞图尔双眼的纹样。这些宝石注入了努曼内拉之力，会使所有击中盾牌的敌人陷入迟缓。

changes.source: The ring is the symbol of a lost cult that worshipped the mythical serpent El-Aemor. This cult specialized in making poison, and crafted these devices from a cache of ancient numenera in their temple. It is said that they once controlled the far north of the Ninth World for a brief period, and legend insists that the mention of El-Aemor still strikes terror in the hearts of some of the inhabitants of that area.
changes.before: 这枚戒指是一个失落教派的象征，该教派崇拜神话中的巨蛇埃尔-艾莫。这个教派专精于制作毒素，并用神庙中一批古老的努曼内拉打造了这些装置。据说他们曾短暂控制第九世界的极北地区，而传说坚称，时至今日，只要提及埃尔-艾莫，该地区一些居民仍会心生恐惧。

changes.source: The mechanisms of similar numenera are oft speculated upon by Aeon Priests; mayhap the weakness in the pattern channels the strike, or echoes ripple backwards through time, or space-time itself is bruised and bent and the wound is merely an expression of such. But those with a deeper understanding of time have a more disturbing answer. The artifact caused the older wound before the fight ever began: a more recent mishap, an inexplicable accident long ago, or even a tragic event in childhood. The injury then troubles the victim, perhaps for years, slowing them such that the current attack lands - and thus causality is preserved.
changes.before: 万世祭司常常推测类似努曼内拉的运作机制；或许纹样中的薄弱处引导了打击，或许回响穿越时间向后荡漾，又或许时空本身受到瘀伤与弯折，而伤口不过是这种情况的表现。但对时间有更深理解的人有一个更令人不安的答案。这件神器在战斗尚未开始前就造成了那道旧伤：可能是不久前的一次不幸，可能是很久以前一场无法解释的事故，甚至可能是童年时的一桩惨剧。这道伤随后困扰受害者，也许持续数年，使其行动迟缓，以至于当前攻击得以命中——于是因果关系得以保全。

changes.source: The finger is slightly withered and decayed. The rigid wiring prevents it from fully bending. The first known appearance of these items is relatively recent - someone pairs the numenera with still-living subjects.
changes.before: 这根手指略微干枯腐朽。僵硬的线路使它无法完全弯曲。这些物品已知的首次出现时间相对较近——有人把努曼内拉与仍然活着的对象配对。

changes.source: Centuries ago, a minor noble named Cettria lived a hermit's life. Obsessed with purity and health, Cettria banned nearly all visitors to his home, and allowed only couriers to take and leave letters. As his eccentricities and fears grew with age, Cettria grew more concerned with undesirables being in his presence. He commissioned a local smith and an Aeon Priest to craft this glove out of some of his numenera so that he could repulse any who came too close. Cettria died alone in his home, the glove unused. No one had found him interesting enough to visit.
changes.before: 几个世纪前，一位名叫塞特利亚的小贵族过着隐士般的生活。塞特利亚痴迷于纯净与健康，禁止几乎所有访客进入他的家园，只允许信使拿取和留下信件。随着年岁增长，他的怪癖与恐惧愈发严重，塞特利亚也越来越在意不受欢迎的人出现在自己面前。他委托当地铁匠和一位万世祭司，用他的一些努曼内拉打造了这只手套，以便击退任何靠得太近的人。塞特利亚独自死在家园中，手套从未被使用。没有人觉得他有趣到愿意前来拜访。

But the moss shifts in unexpected ways, and the pebble vibrates as it does. If held against the skin, the moss latches on and is absorbed, providing powerful resuscitating energies. These pebbles are found by diving into the waters around Sagus Cliffs, perhaps grown by an unknown interaction with the surrounding numenera. The moss was further treated and refined, detached and reattached to the pebble, a process that amplifies the interaction between the two objects and increases the effects when the moss is absorbed.

changes.source:
Welcome to Torment: Tides of Numenera's beta. This build will take you through Sagus Cliffs, which is the first major location in Torment. The story we've created is reactive, detailed and set in a world unlike any other. We encourage you to play multiple times to get a sense of how your choices can change your path through the Ninth World.

This latest version comes with thousands of changes, many directly from our community's feedback and suggestions.
Here's an overview of the biggest:

- 4K backgrounds
- Two new party members available
- New UI artwork and design
- Added merchants and trading
- Character system and Crisis mechanics updates
- Early game sequence reworked
- Improved background art, visual effects and sound effects

Torment is still a ways from final release, and we will continue to polish and improve the game. We encourage you to use the Feedback button at the top of the screen to relay your thoughts or bug reports, as well as on the forums. The messages and comments from our backers and fans are invaluable, and we will be reading them.

Known issues:

- Balance is at an early pass
- Random text errors appear in conversations and barks
- Some side quests may break

Whether you are playing for the first time, or a returning player checking out the newest version, we hope you enjoy your journey...
